description: Sec. VI-C / Fig. 5: phase oracle Z^{x_i}, mechanisms calibrated to a total EA-QDP parameter of 3.
count_key: '<reference bits>|<system bits>': character i of each half is the outcome of qubit pair i (same index as character i of the secret string). Reference bits are measured after CNOT(R_i -> S_i) and H(R_i); system bits are the measured S_i. The reference half is empty when the adversary keeps no reference system (BV).
